label: D2 arrival in S1 right after an a1->S2 rare rewarded trial (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and almost only when the reached state is S1 (99.6% of mass). Its strong activations come from one sequence: on the previous trial the agent chose a1, had a rare transition to S2 and was rewarded, and now the D2 state input is S1. Usually the agent switched to a2 and then had a rare transition to S1. The feature also strongly depends on episode time: nothing fires before trial ~35, and the rate climbs toward trial 99. With ep_trial >= 50 the predicate has dev precision 0.99 and mass recall 0.78, but recall is only 0.43. The many misses are weak, low-quartile activations at other S1 D2 steps, mostly after a common or unrewarded previous trial. It does not fire at D1 or GO, at S2 arrivals, or in the first ~35 trials. Magnitude is largest for the full pattern above; I checked this only through quartile coverage. All variables are observed by D2 (ep_trial is not an input, but the GRU may track elapsed time). No future variables are used.
